## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their outcomes. Distinguish unit/mocked tests, Electron tests, and real Windows/provider observations. Explain unrun checks and platform limitations.

## Privacy and compatibility

Describe any changes to microphone activation, provider traffic, key storage, IPC, clipboard behavior, startup, or profile compatibility. Use synthetic examples; do not attach keys, private transcripts, audio, or clipboard contents.

For release changes, include the applicable evidence from `docs/release-checklist.md`.
